cases.answer_excerpt:

cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: What is the refund policy if I withdraw from a course or program at BCIT after classes start?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you may still be eligible for a tuition refund if you withdraw after classes start, provided you do so by the specific refund deadline for your program or course type. 

* **Full-time programs:** For most full-time programs, your latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of class. Note that commitment fees are non-refundable and will be deducted from your refund.
* **Flexible Learning courses:** Refund eligibility depends on the course length and format (such as classroom-based or distance learning). For example, classroom-based courses lasting more than four weeks offer an 85% tuition refund if withdrawn prior to the second class.
* **Apprenticeship programs:** Refunds depend on how far in advance you withdraw prior to the start of class, and no refunds are issued for withdrawals made nine days or less before classes start.
* **General requirement:** To be eligible for any refund, you must officially submit your refund request within two calendar years of the course start date.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/
sub_queries: BCIT refund policy withdrawal after classes start

cases.question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?

cases.answer_excerpt:
BCIT 간호 학사(Bachelor of Science in Nursing) 프로그램에 입학하려면 경쟁 입학의 2단계(Step 1과 Step 2) 요건을 충족해야 합니다.

  * **영어 능력:** 영어 연구(English Studies) 12 과정 67% 이상 또는 동등한 과정.
  * **수학:** 프리칼큘러스(Pre-Calculus) 11(73%) 또는 12(67%), 혹은 수학 기초(Foundations of Math) 11 또는 12(73%), 기타 인정되는 BC/유콘 과정 또는 MATH 0007(73%) 중 하나.

  * **학술 기초(18.0 학점 이상, 각 67% 이상):** 
    * ENGL 1177(학술 작문) 또는 동등한 과정 3.0 학점.

    * PSYC 1101(입문 심리학 1) 또는 동등한 과정 3.0 학점.
    * 100 수준 이상의 최소 2개 서로 다른 학문 분야의 일반 교양(General Education) 선택 과목 6.0 학점.

* **2단계: 조건부 선발 후 요건**
  * 조건부 합격을 통보받은 후 범죄경력조회(Criminal Record Check)와 예방접종 기록(Immunization Records) 등의 추가 요구사항을 제출해야 최종 합격 처리를 받습니다.
